gaps.scope: county outlets/PR staffing/story mix and event reach
gaps.finding: No commercially cleared county news-desert table or representative content audit established. Best observed audience baseline is Pew’s source-use/attention distribution; it cannot justify stories-per-resignation, fixed newsroom headcount or word-of-mouth speed.

No primary identified causal trait/office-by-story response table. Invitation to comment, comment, decline and nonresponse should be distinguishable, but no coefficient inferred from national news-use rates.

interpretation: Aggregate observations calibrate totals; they do not choose an individual actor outcome. Legal rules apply only to the stated jurisdiction and vintage. Missing coverage is not legal permission. No excluded source or real-person name is included.
